apigen.description: API generation toolchain — core, engine, plugins for TS->API

agent.description: AI agent runtime — orchestrator, providers, stores, MCP server

data.description: Data utilities — structures, transforms, query engine

dispatch.description: Task dispatch — DAG-based execution planning and optimization

environment.description: Environment management — specs, builders, core runtimes for Node, Python, and Rust

ui-react.description: React UI components — hooks, storybook config

base.description: Zero internal cross-dependencies. Roots of the dep graph.

core.description: Depends only on base packages within the same group.

engine.description: Orchestration/wiring layer. Depends on base + core.

query.description: Query/engine layer. Depends on base + core.

plugin.description: Optional extension. Depends on base + core + store. Cannot import other optional packages.

generator.description: Code generator. Depends on base + core. Cannot import other optional packages.

types.description: Pure type definitions. Always access:public. Zero internal deps.

entrypoint.description: Runnable artifact. Lives under entrypoint/. Can depend on any package class.

node.description: Node.js runtime. Can import node built-ins.

browser.description: Browser runtime. Can import DOM APIs.

shared.description: Universal. Safe in both Node and browser. Zero platform-specific imports.
